summary: Cable One, Inc. filed an 8-K to update interim participation in its MBI Term Loan Exchange Offer, a debt exchange for lenders holding MBI Term Loans. As of June 22, 2026, acceptances covered ~33.4% of outstanding loans. The offer, expiring June 23, 2026, allows lenders to exchange loans for cash and new first-lien first-out term loans if the aggregate does not exceed 50.01% of principal, or 100% new first-lien second-out loans otherwise. This is a routine debt management transaction, not a special situation. No strategic event or shareholder value change is warranted; monitor participation levels.
